description: This file defines the BitSetMethods class, providing static methods for manipulating fixed-size uncompressed bitsets, including setting, unsetting, checking bits, and finding the next set bit.

classes.name: BitSetMethods
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for bitset operations, such as setting, unsetting, and querying bits.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the bit at the specified index to true.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Sets the bit at the specified index to false.

methods.name: isSet
methods.description: Checks if the bit at the specified index is set.

methods.name: anySet
methods.description: Checks if any bit in the bitset is set.

methods.name: nextSetBit
methods.description: Finds the index of the next set bit at or after a given starting index.
